data.exact_reserve_text: During 2023 the Syndicate released $89.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2022: $85.9m), arising predominantly from the Casualty, Marine and Treaty divisions (2022: predominantly from the Political Risk & Violence, Marine and Property divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2023.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2023 with gross claims outstanding of $3,372.9m. During 2023 the Syndicate recorded a release of prior year reserves of $89.2m (2.6% of opening gross reserves), driven predominantly by favourable claims development across Casualty, Marine and Treaty portfolios. Prior-year exposures remain material for events such as the Russia/Ukraine crisis, COVID-19 and Hurricane Ian, for which the notes disclose current gross and net estimated ultimates. Current year catastrophe activity (e.g. Cyclone Gabrielle, Auckland Floods, Israel/Gaza Conflict) is quantified separately in the technical reserves note.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are taken from the syndicate annual accounts which are presented in US Dollars. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior year development gross figure taken from Note 4 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states a $89.2m release (treated as negative). Segmental premium mix copied verbatim from the segmental analysis note. Claims development triangle is present in the notes (pages 34-35) but OCR/alignment issues in the provided text made precise extraction of every development cell uncertain; the triangle metadata is provided but detailed development rows have been omitted here to avoid misalignment errors.

_claims_triangle.notes: Claims development table (gross) exists on page 34, but development-period rows were not fully extracted due to OCR/column alignment uncertainty in the source. Use the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note for prior-year development figures.
